meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenCode 配置管理多种 AI 模型提供商
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch between AI model providers in containerized environments

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw的agent不再只能用默认的Claude,还可以通过OpenCode接入OpenRouter、DeepSeek等模型;每个agent组可单独切换后端,并支持配置额外环境变量和MCP服务器。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加OpenCode作为agent provider,且系统检测到缺少相关文件时,自动复制文件、装依赖并重建镜像;之后可用命令切换指定agent组的provider。

say.note: 会执行安装步骤,复制文件并重建镜像。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw agents can use OpenCode as a provider instead of the default Claude, enabling models from OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc. Each agent group can switch its backend individually, with extra env vars and MCP servers supported.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add OpenCode as an agent provider and pre-flight checks find missing files; it copies files, installs deps, rebuilds image. Then you switch a group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`.

say_en.text: Add OpenCode as an agent provider.
say_en.note: Runs the install steps, copies files and rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Switch this agent group to OpenCode with DeepSeek.
say_en.note: Runs ncl groups config update to set the provider.

say_en.text: Set up OpenRouter with the sonnet model.
say_en.note: Sets OPENCODE_PROVIDER and related env vars.
